result.prior_version_note: Under Ord. 25-057 (adopted May 21, 2025; approved by the Mayor May 22, 2025), § 218-12(2)(a) made it unlawful for a real estate lessor, agent or subcontractor to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider. Ord. 25-076 (adopted July 16, 2025; approved by the Mayor July 17, 2025) added 'or otherwise utilize the services of' a Service Provider. It states no effective date, so the current version's effective date is unknown from the documents. The 'June 2025' in-force month comes from a secondary law-firm table (month only). Neither ordinance states its own effective date.
